messages:
Maya: Heads-up 1 Optimize v0.9 announce planned Wed 09:00 PT. Marketing needs: final changelog link, docs URL with tracking, one p95 stat + cost-delta, and the exact SDR routing tag by EOD Tue. Who can confirm?
Sanjay: Ill own changelog permalink. PR merged but will publish the permalink after docs go live. Ref: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/412
Liam: Docs will publish the Optimize guide today. ETA Tue 14:00 PT for canonical URL. Well append ?utm_campaign=optimize_v0.9 on handoff.
Olivia: Rollout plan: canary us-west @ 09:00 PT, 201 observation, then ramp to 100% at ~09:25 PT. Canary will be reachable for screenshots but capacity thottled; will mirror GA code path.
Maya: Important: marketing wants public-facing screenshots to match live. Confirm canary UX parity and share p95 after canary is up.
Samir: Canary matches GA flow. Ill post a p95 dashboard snapshot and a 7-day baseline vs v0.9 CSV within 15 minutes of canary start so design can mock the chart.
Priya: Webinar Thu 10:00 PT is locked. Landing page needs a short blurb + CTA that routes leads to SDR queue 'inbound-launch-optimize'. Please include tag "optimize-launch" and campaign field so ops can auto-route.
Sanjay: Confirmed  webhook payload will include campaign: "optimize_v0.9" and tag: "optimize-launch" exactly. Well coordinate the schema bump with release-bot.
Nora: Reminder: press embargo at 09:00 PT. Do not schedule outbound posts before marketing confirms the canonical links in this thread.
release-bot: Deploy scheduled: optimize/service v0.9 -> canary us-west @ 2025-11-12T09:00:00-08:00; full rollout @ 2025-11-12T09:25:00-08:00. CI: green.
Maya: Final checklist for this thread: 1) changelog permalink, 2) docs URL with ?utm_campaign=optimize_v0.9, 3) two-sentence blurb for socials, 4) p95 screenshot + CSV, 5) sample webhook JSON for SDR ops. Post all here when ready and well schedule the announcement for Wed 09:05 PT. :rocket:
